_readme: Raw candidate list of idiom sentences from draft/c/grammar/83-92.md and 93-103.md that did NOT substring-match any existing uttrykk-c.json entry (norsk/lemma field). Generated by cross-referencing the parsed idiom sentences against uttrykk-c.json, using the correct paraphrase from draft/c/grammar/answers.md as the 'correct_paraphrase' field. NOT all of these are genuine uttrykk candidates -- see ai-docs/implementation/c-uttrykk-addition.md for the required manual filtering step (many are ordinary single-word synonym tests, not fixed idiomatic chunks). Each entry needs: (1) manual extraction of the canonical idiom/lemma form, (2) a decision per data-rules/vocab-and-uttrykk.md on whether it's uttrykk vs vocab vs skip, (3) full multi-locale fields authored before merging into uttrykk-c.json.
